scope: Current clan territory war (warfare_version=4), all 12 tactical skills; no map redesign deployment

policy.voters: ACTIVE participants on the same side
policy.damageBasis: Current commander snapshot, or highest-ranked active participant before commander election

integrity: duplicate and replayed votes do not increase headcount
round lock serializes vote switching and automatic casts
count, cooldown, front, commander and effect guards are checked in the effect transaction
damage, facility power, cooldown, activation receipt and vote consumption commit together
failed casts retain votes and resume automatically in the normal territory lifecycle
old frontend activation endpoint also requires votes for current rounds

release.reason: Local territory tactical voting change using existing transaction tables; verify voting, skill effects and UI, without changing common authentication, DB infrastructure, dependencies or unrelated content.
